the complainant along with his staff on credible information seized the auto bearing No.AP 07 TE 6340 and caught hold the petitioners/A.l to A.3,
seized the banned products under a cover of police proceedings and arrested the petitioners/A.l to A.3.

Later, he registered the mediators report as a case in Crime No.207 of 2019 for the offences stated supra.
3.
